text:
ana_support: FYI customer on Dedicated hit truncated SSE responses behind ALB + nginx sidecar. Stream starts, a few events then abrupt EOF mid-chunk. Customer sees partial JSON and client reconnect loop. Ticket# 3241. 

samir_eng: Can you paste repro steps + a raw curl capture? Also want the ALB type (internal/inet), and whether there's Cloudflare in front.

ana_support: Repro steps below — this is what the customer ran from their app host.
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-prod.example/v1/streams/resp?model=redwood-prod-1" > sse.out
```
Output truncated like: 
```
event: message
data: {"type":"delta","text":"The quick brown"}

(event: message with some more chunks)
<connection closed, client sees EOF mid-json: "...brown fox
" and reconnects>
```
They also captured `curl -v` TLS/HTTP lines: 
```
* Connected to api.redwood-prod.example (10.0.0.35) port 443 (#0)
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
...
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS alert, close notify (256)
* Closing connection 0
```

jules_sre: Important to check ALB idle timeout and nginx proxy_read_timeout. ALB default 60s will half-close targets on idle. SSE needs either heartbeats or ALB idle > expected idle window. Also check if nginx has `proxy_buffering on` — that breaks streaming.

samir_eng: Can we get the nginx sidecar config from the customer's envoy/nginx? Also need ALB target-group type (instance/ip) and whether target health shows resets.

ana_support: They shared this snippet from their sidecar (we redacted hostnames):
```
location /v1/streams/ {
  proxy_pass http://upstream_svc;
  proxy_buffering on;
  proxy_buffers 8 16k;
  proxy_read_timeout 60s;
  proxy_send_timeout 60s;
}
```

jules_sre: There you go — `proxy_buffering on` + `proxy_read_timeout 60s` + ALB default 60s is a bad combo. If upstream has no traffic for ~60s, ALB will terminate the target connection, nginx will see a half-close and may not flush buffered chunk to client, producing partial/mid-chunk EOF.

samir_eng: Also worth checking if ALB is doing HTTP/2 with clients and HTTP/1.1 to targets — the translation can interact badly with chunk flush semantics. Any nginx error logs?

ana_support: Pasted nginx error around the time: 
```
2024/06/20 13:45:03 [error] 1024#0: *345 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.1.2.3, server: _, request: "GET /v1/streams/... HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.0.5.8:3000/v1/streams/...", host: "api.redwood-prod.example"
```
ALB access log (redacted): 
```
... target_status=200 target_processing_time=24.539 connection_termination=LB
```

jules_sre: connection_termination=LB confirms ALB closed the connection. Root cause likely ALB idle timeout or a keepalive/half-close mismatch.

samir_eng: Workaround + fixes: 
- Disable proxy_buffering for SSE route: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_cache off;`
- Increase `proxy_read_timeout` to something > ALB idle (eg 300s) or match expected client heartbeat interval.
- Increase ALB idle timeout to 120 or 300s (if you control it) OR add application heartbeats every 20–30s.
- Ensure upstream flushes after each SSE event: `ngx.flush()` or `res.flush()` depending on framework; send a `:\n` heartbeat event every 25s.
- If Cloudflare is in front, enable `Origin Keep-Alive` and disable Cloudflare response buffering for this route (turn off `cache` or use a page rule to bypass).

deploy_bot: deploy event: `deploy:api-streams @ commit 1a2b3c4 — rolled out to prod-sidecar group at 2024-06-20T14:00:00Z`

samir_eng: Also asked infra: if customer uses ALB + nginx sidecar on same host, make sure the sidecar isn't coalescing writes — verify `tcp_nodelay on` and `sendfile off` depending on sidecar. For HTTP/2, verify `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection "";` to allow chunked streaming.

ana_support: Customer applied two quick mitigations: set `proxy_buffering off` on SSE location + increased ALB idle timeout to 180s. They report reconnects dropped dramatically but see rare partial chunk events ~1/day.

jules_sre: If rare, next steps: enable request-level tracing for a failing session (capture tcpdump on target/sidecar, and ALB access logs upped to full). Also look for middleboxes (corporate proxies) and client SDK behavior (some HTTP/2 clients buffer until a threshold).

samir_eng: Action items:
- Customer: keep `proxy_buffering off`; add lightweight SSE heartbeat `event: ping\ndata: {}\n\n` every 25s.
- Support: collect one failing tcpdump + `curl -v` for a repro when it happens.
- Eng: add streaming checklist to docs: ALB idle timeout guidance, nginx/Envoy flags, Cloudflare buffering note.

ana_support: I'll follow up with customer to collect a tcpdump on next occurrence and will offer to run a short side-by-side test with our staging ALB settings. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
